proposed.sourceName: Darul Iftaa Mahmudiyyah (Lusaka, Zambia) — Fatwa #1297 (Mufti Bilal Pandor)
proposed.paraphrase: Holds that bread containing L-cysteine is doubtful (mushbooh) and should be avoided unless the source is verified, because E920 may be derived from human hair or pork; it is permissible only when sourced from bird feathers, halal animals, or vegetables.

proposed.sourceName: Askimam (Darul Iftaa, Mufti Ebrahim Desai) — Fatwa 13859 on L-cysteine source
proposed.paraphrase: A Hanafi ruling that L-cysteine (E920) is halal if made from chicken/duck feathers but not halal if made from human hair — the ruling depends entirely on the verified source. (Standing fatwa, accessed 2026-07-01.)

researcherNote: E920/animal seeded lenient grade 4 (widely avoided). Kept at 'avoid' rather than raised: even leniently, human-hair/pork-source E920 is not halal (Askimam) and to be avoided unless verified (Zambia). Two independent tier-1. APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
